method: POS-aware WordNet lemmatisation; content words plus legal modals/negation; TF-IDF cosine similarity. LDA topics chosen by UMass coherence on a fixed 75% training sample, k=2..5, refitted on all texts.

translation_policy: Checked translations are the de facto English texts with the same weighting as official English texts. All selected primary passages must be checked. No 80-word exclusion in the main comparison; short excerpts are flagged and tested separately.
adaptation: Follows Gurrola-Perez and Lin (2024), Section 5: POS/lemmatisation, word importance, LDA keywords and jurisdiction counts. Their source texts use official English translations; ours additionally use checked research translations. UMass coherence, seed tests and nearest matches are explicit extensions; not a replication.
scope: One selected primary source per jurisdiction; pathway, limited-scope and explanatory texts separately identified. Translated readability is not evidence about original-language drafting complexity.
